updates.author: Jessica Booker
updates.title: HRT labs not required for pilot program patients
updates.body: HRT Labs not required for specific patients We have successfully been seeing New York HRT patients with no labs for several weeks now. We are going to broaden the pilot program to several other patients in different states. Please ALWAYS first check to see if a lab order was generated. If no lab order was generated, that means they are part of our no labs pilot program. Please do not offer labs to these patients.
